title: QA-harness fidelity: devPatch MCP operand + its rtl-verif duplicate + deprecated pins + settings/HOME + timing flake + dual-track boot (single skills writer, single re-pin)
theme: These were gates that manufactured their own pass: a broken dev-flavor MCP operand stayed invisible because stub env pins bypassed the B8 launcher, a duplicated devPatch propagated the same bug, a case ran against the real HOME, a hard 60s deadline read a healthy 68.7s boot as a capability failure, and a live case could not boot at all.

A1_devPatch_operand.defect: `.split("@mpd-dsh/mpd/").join(repoRoot + "/")` rewrote only the tail of the packed operand, leaving `+ "/node_modules/"`, so MCP row commands became `<baseUrl>/node_modules/<abs-repo>/packages/...` which exists nowhere.
A1_devPatch_operand.fix: consume the WHOLE operand: drop the `(typeof baseUrl ...) + ` concat and rewrite the leading `"/node_modules/@mpd-dsh/mpd/` to the checkout root, producing `process.env.MPD_DSH_X || ("<repo>/packages/.../launch.mjs")`.
A1_devPatch_operand.self_test_guard: each of preset-register/rtl-verif/dual-track asserts the rewritten patch contains no `typeof baseUrl`, no `/node_modules/@mpd-dsh/mpd/`, no bare `name: '@mpd-dsh/mpd'`, and that each MCP operand equals the checkout-absolute launcher path that also exists on disk.

A2_codegraph_smoke_pin_documented.note: MPD_CODEGRAPH_BIN stays BY DESIGN (the case exists to exercise that binary) and now carries an explicit comment plus a SKILL.md row note saying its green is not evidence for the bundle's B8 resolution chain.

A3_mcp_call_settings_and_home.fix: settings.yaml copied when present (alongside .credentials.yaml, at both DSH_HOME and the HOME-shaped location) and HOME is now sandboxed, so the case can no longer read/write real `~/.mpd` state (it previously died on `mkdir '/root/.mpd/codegraph'`, see F-B8-1).

A4_web_client_adapt_deadline.fix: boot-graph deadline 60s -> 150s, env-overridable via MPD_DSH_QA_WEB_BOOT_DEADLINE_MS, and bootEntry now records elapsedMs/deadlineMs/timedOut so a slow boot is visibly bounded instead of reading as a missing client entry.
A4_web_client_adapt_deadline.measurement: a healthy SOLO run measured elapsedMs=68723 (> the old 60s deadline) and passed.

A5_dual_track_boot.defect: passed the committed packed patch to a bare `--profile headless` -> `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND @mpd-dsh/mpd` (`<tmp>/profiles/headless/node_modules/@mpd-dsh/mpd/packages/...`), making the wave-2 workspace-isolation fix in that case inert.
A5_dual_track_boot.fix: dev-flavor rewrite of the patch into the sandbox (same helper shape as preset-register/rtl-verif) before booting; self-test asserts no packed operand remains.

A6_vendor_lock_repin.fix: exactly ONE skills re-pin, computed with verify-vendor.mjs's own algorithm (LF-normalized per-file sha256 + sorted relpath aggregation); fileCount unchanged at 366.

evidence.second_independent_boot: evidence/dsh-qa/rtl-verif/2026-09-11T08-22-44.955Z (ok=true, bootExit=0, lsp dual, verilator flow green, 0 module errors)

verification.affected --self-test: preset-register, rtl-verif, mcp-call, dual-track-smoke, codegraph-smoke, web-client-adapt: all exit 0
verification.real_cases: preset-register PASS; rtl-verif PASS; web-client-adapt PASS; dual-track-smoke and mcp-call blocked ONLY by the absent DeepSeek API key

environment_limitations: This sandbox has no DeepSeek API key: ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml holds only a client-connection/browser-session grant and settings.yaml has `llm-deepseek: {}`. Live-LLM lanes (dual-track-smoke, mcp-call) therefore end in MISSING_CREDENTIAL. Both now get all the way to the model step — no module-resolution or real-HOME crash remains — and their structural assertions are covered by --self-test.
